note: Black Hills NF campground on the south shore of Pactola Reservoir, the largest reservoir in the Black Hills, ~17 mi W of Rapid City via SD-44 and US-385: three loops in pine forest, all non-electric (generators 6 a.m.-10 p.m.), several sites with reservoir views; swim beach, boat launches and the Pactola Pines Marina nearby. Loop B is closed for construction from Aug 2026 to late June 2027. --Claude
